h: The Haftaros Carry Concealed Repair Toward the Revelation of Salvation

p: in which there is toil and service
the retributions are brought to an end.
And after this, "the seven of consolation,"
which correspond to the seven holy attributes
And it is like the saying of our Sages, of blessed memory:
and those who curse and afflict them
come before those who bless them."
alludes to the aspect of Kesser,
for speech is the attribute of Malchus,
as is found in Pesach Eliyahu:
and "Kesser Elyon is the crown of Malchus,"
"He tells the end from the beginning" (Yeshayahu 46:10);
as it was right at the creation of the world:
who was the ultimate aim of creation,
and was created last of all creatures.
whom it arose in thought to create:
the ultimate aim of the kelipah
and he was the beginning of the thought,
and he was born last of the seventy nations.
וּבְסוֹף הַכֹּל נִבְרָא יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
And at the end of all, Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him, was created,
And all the words of Yirmiyahu
and as it appears on the surface,
he accomplished nothing with all his words,
as is found in the Midrash,
that he said to them after the Destruction:
"Had you listened to my words beforehand,
you would not have come to this."
וְהוּא כְּעִנְיַן הַנֶּאֱמָר בִּיחֶזְקֵאל (יְחֶזְקֵאל ג, יח־יט)
And it is like what is said in Yechezkel (Yechezkel 3:18-19):
"When I say to the wicked, You shall surely die,
and you did not warn him, etc.,
he, the wicked one, shall die in his iniquity, etc.;
but you, if you warned the wicked one
and he did not turn from his wickedness,
he shall die in his iniquity,
and you have saved your soul."
once he had already warned him,
even though he did not repent.
And reason would suggest the opposite:
that the deliberate sinner, whom he already rebuked,
than the unwitting one whom he did not warn.
But this one, whom the prophet rebuked,
even though he did not listen to him,
his death was an atonement for his iniquity,
and he was no longer called "wicked."
is also a prophecy of Yirmiyahu,
and it alludes to the aspect of Chochmah,
שֶׁהוּא גַּם כֵּן לְמַעְלָה מִן הַדַּעַת
it is the aspect of something from nothing.
For the one who hears at any rate
even though it does not yet enter the heart;
there is some hope for this
"Fortunate is the man who listens to me,
to watch at the doorposts of my entrances"
when they open the door for him.
And this is the matter of the aspect of Yirmiyahu,
corresponds to the aspect of Binah,
that is, it has already come
"And my heart has seen much wisdom";
רוֹאֶה אֲנִי אֶת דִּבְרֵי אַדְמוֹן (בָּבָא בַּתְרָא קלט, ב)
"I see the words of Admon" (Bava Basra 139b).
And it is from the prophecy of Yeshayahu,
to the aspect of revelation of salvation
עַל פִּי תְּפִיסַת הָאָדָם גַּם כֵּן
according to human grasp as well.
And from this it is close to coming
which is the ultimate revelation of salvation.
And it is found in the Pesikta (on "Divrei")
regarding whom the term "forming" is said:
and of Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him
"Who formed me from the womb to be His servant";
"Before I formed you in the womb I knew you."
of whom forming "from the womb" is said,
that is, regarding existence and revelation;
but of Yirmiyahu it is said,
that is, in the aspect of Ayin,

paragraphs.text: Source: Bava Basra 139b — “מי שמת והניח בנים ובנות; בזמן שהנכסים מרובין – הבנים יירשו, והבנות יזונו. נכסים מועטין – הבנות יזונו, והבנים ישאלו על הפתחים. אדמון אומר: בשביל שאני זכר, הפסדתי?! אמר רבן גמליאל: רואה אני את דברי אדמון.” (Oz Vehadar print, p. 1077) — “MISHNA: In the case of one who died and left behind both sons and daughters, when the estate is large the sons inherit the estate and the daughters are provided with sustenance from it according to the stipulations of the deceased’s marriage contract with their mother. With regard to a small estate, which is insufficient …”
